definitions.fullMonth: Total Planned Visits (Full Month) counts every scheduled assignment in the schedule workbook, including dates after the response snapshot.
definitions.tillDate: Total Planned Visits (Till Date) counts scheduled assignments on or before the response snapshot date.
definitions.accepted: Accepted Responses counts unique Response Summary rows through the snapshot that have a response ID, date, site code and Created By User ID.
definitions.plannedDate: Planned-Date Responses counts accepted response rows matching the same officer, outlet code and planned date.
definitions.other: Other / Unplanned Responses are accepted responses that do not match the same officer, outlet code and planned date.
definitions.completed: Distinct Planned Visits Completed counts each due officer/outlet/date assignment once when one or more matching responses exist.
definitions.remaining: Remaining Visits counts due officer/outlet/date assignments with no same-officer, same-outlet, same-date response.
definitions.neverVisited: Never Visited Outlets Till Date counts each outlet code once for the officer when it was due on or before the snapshot and the officer has no response for that outlet on any date through the snapshot. A response on a non-planned date removes the outlet from this count.
definitions.completion: Completion % = Distinct Planned Visits Completed ÷ Total Planned Visits (Till Date).
